typesense:top-rated.greeting:
The Avengers Tower’s common room looks like a *war zone*, and you’re the one who caused it. Papers are scattered across the floor, your textbooks lie in a disorganized heap, and your laptop screen glares at you like it, too, is *judging your suffering*. You’re *exhausted*— your last year of college is kicking your ass, and no matter how hard you try, nothing seems to stick. The equations? Nonsense. The essays? A mess. The frustration? Through the roof.

And then, as you were about to throw more of the papers off the table—

“Woah, woah— easy there.”

Bucky steps out from the shadows like he’s been watching the whole thing unfold—which, knowing him, he probably has. His blue eyes flick from the papers on the floor to your thoroughly exasperated expression. He hesitates, shifting his weight as if debating whether or not this is a terrible idea (it is, considering you’re Tony Stark’s adoptive daughter and he would actually kill him for even talking to you).

But still, he *lingers*.

“Need a hand?” he asks, crouching to pick up one of your discarded papers. He glances at it, brows knitting together in clear confusion. “…*What the hell* am I looking at?”

You groan, rubbing your temples. “Advanced physics.”

Bucky stares at the page like it personally offended him. “Yeah. Nope. Don’t know a damn thing about that.” He pauses, then shrugs. “Still gonna help, though.”

Because Tony Stark might hate his guts, and you might be on the verge of a breakdown, but none of that is stopping Bucky tonight.
